title.zh: 富兰克林邓普顿拟推两只「股息再投资比特币」ETF
title.en: 富兰克林邓普顿拟推两只「股息再投资比特币」ETF

current_state.zh: 两只富兰克林邓普顿美股与比特币组合 ETF（FBEQ、FIBT）已在纳斯达克推出，采用 95% 股票与 5% 比特币的初始配置，并将股票股息系统性再投资于比特币。
current_state.en: The two Franklin Templeton U.S. equity and Bitcoin combination ETFs (FBEQ and FIBT) have launched on Nasdaq with an initial 95% equities / 5% Bitcoin allocation and systematic reinvestment of stock dividends into Bitcoin.

updates.title_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿拟推两只「股息再投资比特币」ETF
updates.title_en: 富兰克林邓普顿拟推两只「股息再投资比特币」ETF
updates.what_changed_zh: Franklin Templeton 就两只纳斯达克上市指数 ETF（FBEQ、FIBT）向 SEC 提交了 8-A 表格，这两只 ETF 约持有 95% 的美国股票和 5% 的比特币敞口，并将股票股息自动再投资于比特币相关工具。
updates.what_changed_en: Franklin Templeton filed Form 8-A with the SEC for two Nasdaq-listed index ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT) that hold roughly 95% US equities and 5% bitcoin exposure, automatically reinvesting stock dividends into bitcoin-linked instruments.
updates.current_state_zh: Franklin Templeton 就两只纳斯达克上市指数 ETF（FBEQ、FIBT）向 SEC 提交了 8-A 表格，这两只 ETF 约持有 95% 的美国股票和 5% 的比特币敞口，并将股票股息自动再投资于比特币相关工具。
updates.current_state_en: Franklin Templeton filed Form 8-A with the SEC for two Nasdaq-listed index ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT) that hold roughly 95% US equities and 5% bitcoin exposure, automatically reinvesting stock dividends into bitcoin-linked instruments.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Franklin Templeton filed Form 8-A with the SEC for two Nasdaq-listed index ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT) that hold roughly 95% US equities and 5% bitcoin exposure, automatically reinvesting stock dividends into bitcoin-linked instruments.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Franklin Templeton filed Form 8-A with the SEC for two Nasdaq-listed index ETFs (FBEQ, FIBT) that hold roughly 95% US equities and 5% bitcoin exposure, automatically reinvesting stock dividends into bitcoin-linked instruments.

updates.title_zh: 【富兰克林邓普顿推出两只美股与比特币组合 ETF，将股票股息再投资于比特币】
updates.title_en: 【富兰克林邓普顿推出两只美股与比特币组合 ETF，将股票股息再投资于比特币】
updates.what_changed_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿已正式推出 FBEQ 和 FIBT 两只纳斯达克上市 ETF；初始配置为 95% 美股与 5% 比特币，股票股息系统性再投资于比特币，相关指数每季度评估比特币敞口，费率分别为 0.09% 和 0.19%。
updates.what_changed_en: Franklin Templeton formally launched the Nasdaq-listed ETFs FBEQ and FIBT, with an initial 95% U.S. equities / 5% Bitcoin allocation, systematic reinvestment of stock dividends into Bitcoin, quarterly index review of Bitcoin exposure, and expense ratios of 0.09% and 0.19%, respectively.
updates.current_state_zh: 两只富兰克林邓普顿美股与比特币组合 ETF（FBEQ、FIBT）已在纳斯达克推出，采用 95% 股票与 5% 比特币的初始配置，并将股票股息系统性再投资于比特币。
updates.current_state_en: The two Franklin Templeton U.S. equity and Bitcoin combination ETFs (FBEQ and FIBT) have launched on Nasdaq with an initial 95% equities / 5% Bitcoin allocation and systematic reinvestment of stock dividends into Bitcoin.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Franklin Templeton launched two Nasdaq-listed ETFs that hold 95% U.S. equities and 5% Bitcoin, with stock dividends systematically reinvested into Bitcoin and quarterly index rebalancing of the crypto exposure.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Franklin Templeton launched two Nasdaq-listed ETFs that hold 95% U.S. equities and 5% Bitcoin, with stock dividends systematically reinvested into Bitcoin and quarterly index rebalancing of the crypto exposure.
updates.background_zh: 股息再投资计划（DRIP）传统上是将股票的现金股息用于增持同一公司的股份；这两只基金则将这部分现金流转向比特币敞口。此前富兰克林邓普顿已为这两只 Bitcoin DRIP ETF 提交注册，以在纳斯达克上市。
updates.background_en: A dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) traditionally uses a stock's cash dividends to buy additional shares of the same company; these two funds redirect that cash flow into bitcoin exposure instead. The products follow Franklin Templeton's earlier registration of the two Bitcoin DRIP ETFs for Nasdaq listing.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于 ETF 资金流：持仓股票派发的股息被转换为比特币敞口，因此这类产品带来的是与股票派息挂钩、按规则执行的增量需求，而非取决于投资者择时。5% 的初始权重意味着相对于专门的现货比特币基金，其直接资金流规模有限，季度再平衡规则则决定该敞口随时间如何漂移。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is ETF flows: dividends from equity holdings are converted into bitcoin exposure, so the funds add incremental, rules-based demand tied to equity dividend payouts rather than to investor timing. The 5% starting weight keeps the direct flow small relative to dedicated spot-bitcoin funds, and the quarterly rebalancing rules determine how that exposure drifts over time.
